amourAmitie.r1_d: Nothing in your answers spills over the edges of friendship. The pleasure of being together, the trust, the confidences: it's all there, and nothing more. That is precious, and it is not a consolation prize.
amourAmitie.r1_a: Enjoy it without second-guessing. Friendships of this calibre can be counted on one hand in a lifetime.
amourAmitie.r2_t: A friendship, with a little something
amourAmitie.r2_d: The core is friendship, but two or three answers stick out of the frame: a look held a little long, a sting here and there. Nothing that demands a conversation, but enough that you noticed it yourself.
amourAmitie.r2_a: Don't force anything. If that little something grows, you will see it without needing a test.
amourAmitie.r3_d: You still use the vocabulary of friendship, but your reactions tell another story: jealousy creeping in, the effort with your appearance, the messages read twice. It's no longer quite friendship, and it's not yet owned.
amourAmitie.r3_a: Confusion at this level does not dissolve on its own. It grows or it wears out, and you had better know which of the two you are hoping for.
amourAmitie.r4_d: Most of your answers can no longer be explained by friendship. Nobody is jealous of a friend's dates, and nobody keeps putting off the moment of leaving a friend's place. The word "friend" fits less and less, and you know it.
amourAmitie.r4_a: The question is no longer "what do I feel" but "what do I do with it". Take the time you need, just not years.
amourAmitie.r5_t: It's love, only the words are missing
amourAmitie.r5_d: Almost everything is there: the longing, the jealousy, the absolute preference, the racing heart. What you call friendship, anyone on the outside would call something else.
amourAmitie.r5_a: The real risk is no longer declaring yourself. It's that someone else does it before you.
amourAmitie.r6_d: This score is not reached by accident. You didn't come looking for an answer, you came looking for permission. Here it is: what you are living is love, and calling it friendship no longer protects anyone.
amourAmitie.r6_a: The only question left is whether the other person is at the same point. No test can answer that for you. A conversation can.
